review:
Hot Slot: 777 Diamond Crown is a classic sevens-and-fruits slot on 10 fixed paylines, built around four jackpots. Crown Scatter symbols drive the action: landing more of them climbs the MINI, MINOR, MAJOR and GRAND ladder.

The GRAND Jackpot is worth 5,000x the bet and can be won two ways – five Crown Scatters, or a full screen of 15 Seven symbols. Chance Level lets you multiply the base bet by up to 10x to improve the odds of jackpot combinations. Wazdan rates it medium-high volatility with a 96.15% RTP. It suits players who like simple retro reels but want a real jackpot to aim for.
